steps.observable_result: The Stage Agent has read the portable package and the current decision-log.md.

If current facts already make behavior precise, research is recorded as skipped with the reason; otherwise the existing spec-research package returns executed findings or a truthful unavailable result, and only durable facts needed by spec.md are carried forward.

Only when a material specification ambiguity remains, the unique spec-clarify owner performs one real ask → wait → matching user reply → resume cycle; the card, round, and hash are checked, and no reply or wrong reply remains incomplete rather than inferred.
spec.md describes the current product behavior from the decision log, conditional research facts, and any confirmed specification clarification.
Deletion, narrowing, and reuse decisions are reflected directly in spec.md.
Problem, scope, value, alternatives, and product direction are checked and reflected in spec.md.
UI scope receives design review; non-UI scope records why it is not applicable in spec.md.
The current spec.md contains requirements, flows, states, boundaries, FR, AC, non-goals, and deferred work.

One independent findings-review adapter run of the current spec.md is recorded under quality/reviews/; provider, transport and unavailable facts stay honest and this review is advice, not pass permission.
Valid findings are repaired in spec.md; rejected or deferred findings retain their reasons in the current material or quality facts.

The Stage Agent gives a plain-language handoff explaining what the spec does, key flows, boundaries, research/clarify facts, review outcome, risks, and the next stage; the comment is notification, not a gate.
